items.name: advanced-web-crawler
items.description: Single-page web fetch + search + local document parse. Built on Kazma core tools (not a multi-page spider or anti-bot product).

items.name: arabic-bilingual-nlp
items.description: Bilingual processing, context-preserving translation, Hijri-Gregorian date converter, and Tashkeel/vocalisation injector

items.name: browser-automation
items.description: Headless browser automation via Playwright — navigate, click, extract text, screenshot, fill forms, and evaluate JavaScript on live web pages.

items.name: calendar
items.description: Read and manage calendar events — list, create, update, delete, and find free time slots. Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook when connected (vault-backed OAuth; Settings → Email → the calendar card

items.name: chat-platform-dispatcher
items.description: Multi-channel notifications and interactive human-in-the-loop action card dispatchers for Slack, Discord, and Telegram

items.name: code-review
items.description: Review a file or diff and return findings. Read-only — do not modify files or run mutating commands.

items.name: code-analyzer-linter
items.description: Static code analysis, security linting, ruff auto-formatting, and pytest test suite execution

items.name: database-client
items.description: Relational database manager with schema extraction and secured read-only SQLite/database query executions

items.name: document-generator
items.description: Generate verified PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and Markdown artifacts in isolated workers.

items.name: document-platform
items.description: PREFERRED document surface. Durable ingestion, status, paged read, indexing, conversion, redaction and search via the shared DocumentIngestionService — opaque IDs, tenant ACL, versioning, audit and re

items.name: document-processor
items.description: Read, inspect, convert, mutate, securely redact, and generate verified documents in isolated workers.

items.name: email-manager
items.description: Full email integration: list/get/send/delete/categorize/analyze, across every connected mailbox (the main Gmail and Microsoft accounts and any others added in Settings; email_accounts lists them). Pro

items.name: environment-bootstrapper
items.description: Self-healing runtime checks, environment diagnostic profiling, and dynamic package installer (pip, npm)

items.name: fix-lint
items.description: Run the project linter (ruff/mypy) over a file or the workspace, then fix reported issues using the file tools.

items.name: git-github-manager
items.description: Manage local git repositories and integrate with GitHub APIs

items.name: refactor-file
items.description: Refactor a source file for readability and maintainability, then run the project's tests/linter, operating only within the active workspace via the shared file/exec tools.

items.name: secret-vault
items.description: Encrypted secret vault for API keys, tokens, and credentials. Stores secrets with AES-256-GCM encryption.

items.name: system-health-monitor

items.name: task-scheduler-cron

items.name: visual-interpreter-generator
items.description: Multi-modal screenshot and wireframe analyzer, and dynamic UI mockup/image generator

items.name: write-tests
items.description: Generate unit tests (pytest) for a given source file, write them into the workspace with the file tools, and run them.

items.name: x-publisher

items.description: Conventional commit style for this repository. Use when writing commit messages, proposing a commit, or squashing PR commits.

items.name: kazma-release-notes
items.description: Generate release notes from git history. Use when the user asks for release notes, a changelog entry, or "what changed since the last release".

items.description: Kazma Web UI conventions for editing kazma-ui templates and JS. Use when changing the Kazma web UI (dialogs, toasts, Alpine panels, grids).
